<p><strong>1. Cash buffer:</strong> Hold:
1. Xihlayisi xa mali: Bata malembe 1-2 ya swilo swa vutomi eka mali leyi vonakalaka kumbe mbarika wa mali. Humesa eka leswi hi nkarhi wa ku wisa ka mbarika, u nyika ti-equity nkarhi wo veleka handle ko sindzisa ku xavisa.

2. Makungu ya xichayela: Avanyisa xiphemu eka xiyimo xa le kusuhi (mali, malembe 1-3), xa le xikarhi (bodo ni swilo swa mali, malembe 3-7), ni xa le kule (ti-equity, malembe 7+). Rhumela xiyimo xa le kusuhi ku suka eka lexi xa le xikarhi loko mbarika wu tlakukile.

3. Ku humesa hi ku ntshunxeka: Hunguta ku humesa hi malembe yo biha (tirhisa ntsongo, humesa ntsongo). Hambi ku ri ku hunguta hi 10% eka ku humesa hi lembe ro biha swiantswisa vutomi bya xiphemu swinene.

4. Annunity ya vutomi yi yelana ni guaranteed annuity: Guaranteed annuity yi hundzisela khombo ra nate eka mu-insurer hi ku nyikela hi capital. Living annuity yi hlayisa ku ntshunxeka kambe yi veka munhu loyi a wiseke eka khombo ra nate. Vahlaluri vo tala va nyikela hi ku hlangana.
<p><strong>1. Comprehensive:</strong> Co:
1. Comprehensive: Yi funengeta movha wa wena swin'we ni ku onha ka munhu wa vunharhu. Yidurha ngopfu.

2. Third-Party, Fire & Theft: Yi funengeta van'wana loko u endla khombo, swin'we ni ndzilo ni ku homboloka ka movha wa wena.

3. Third-Party Only: Yi funengeta ku onha loku u ku endlaka eka van'wana. Yi onhiwa hi ntsongo, naswona hi yona leyi ringanyetiwaka.

E-SA, ku chayela handle ka inshuwarenisi swi vula leswaku WENA u hakela ku onha ka swilo swa van'wana hi mali ya wena.
<p><strong>1. EBITDA Multiple (earnings-:
1. EBITDA Multiple (earnings-based): Leyi tolovelekile ngopfu eka mabindzu lama tirhaka. Ntsengo = EBITDA × multiple ya indasitiri. Ti-SME multiples ta SA ti famba hi 2-5× EBITDA (ku yelana na 8-15× ya ti-company leti tsarisileke). Khabinete ya vutshila leyi nga ni R2m EBITDA yi nga xavisiwa hi R6-8m (3-4× EBITDA). Swiyenge leswi tlakusaka multiple: mali leyi ngenaka hi ntolovelo, vaxavi vo hambanahambana, timu ya nkongomiso leyi nga titshegingi hi n'wini, ndlela yo kula leyi tiyileke.

2. Discounted Cash Flow (DCF): Ringanyeta mali ya vumundzuku leyi ntshunxekeke, hunguta eka xiyimo xa khombo (WACC). Yi twisiseka eka vutlhari kambe yi rhendzeleke eka mimpimo. Yi tirhisiwa ngopfu eka mabindzu lamanene kumbe hi vahlaluri va timali hi nkarhi wa ku kambisisa.

3. Net Asset Value (NAV): Swilo leswi humesiweke eka swikweleti hi ntsengo wa mbarika. Yi tirhisiwa eka mabindzu lama hlayisaka swilo (tikhampani ta akayi, migodi, miako). Hakanyingi i ntsengo wo sungula, bindzu ra vuhlayisi ri fanele ku va ni ntsengo lowu kulu ku tlula xiyenge xa rona.
<p><strong>1. Harvesting losses:</strong:
1. Ku hlengeleta ku homboloka: Loko u ri ni ku homboloka loku nga vonakiki eka xiphemu xa wena, tiendlele kona hi lembe ra mhakaxaxa leri fanaka ni ku kuma lokukulu. Ku homboloka ku lulamisa ku kuma rand-for-rand emahlweni ka xiyenge xa ku nghenisa xi tirha.

2. Ku hangalasa ku xavisa eka malembe ya mhakaxaxa: Ku ntshunxeka ka lembe na lembe i tirhisa-sweswi-kumbe-u-heleriwa. Loko u kunguhata ku xavisa xiyenge lexikulu, ku fambisa ku xavisa hi malembe yo tala ku tirhisa ku ntshunxeka ka R40 000 ko tala.

3. TFSA wrapper: Swilo leswi nga endzeni ka Akhawunti ya ku Hlayisa leyi Ntshunxekeke eka Mhakaxaxa (TFSA) swi ni zero CGT, hi nkarhi hinkwawo. Ku khoma swilo leswi kulaka (equity ETFs) eka TFSA ya wena swi herisa CGT eka swilo swoleswo hilaha ku nga heriki.

4. Nyiko eka PBO: Ku nyikela hi xiyenge lexi tlakukile hi ku kongoma eka n'wangula wa Section 18A public benefit organisation a swi hlayisiwi eka CGT naswona swi humesa ku hungutiwa ka mhakaxaxa ku fika eka 10% ya mali leyi ngenaka ya mhakaxaxa.
<p><strong>1. Inter vivos trust:</strong:
1. Inter vivos trust: Hundzisela swilo leswi kulaka eka trust sweswi. Ku kula ka vumundzuku ku wela handle ka estate ya wena. Ku hundzisa ku pfuxa CGT sweswi (nkoka wa nkarhi wun'we) kambe ku susa ku kula loku fambaka ka ku hlayisa estate duty.

2. Life assurance (Section 3(3)(a)): Polisi ya vutomi laha estate yi nga mu-beneficiary yi nghenisiwile eka estate leyi hakeriwaka kambe mu-insurer u hakela duty. Tipolisi leti tiakiwile ku seketela estate duty, premiums ti hakela emahlweni estate duty ya wena hi ti-installment.

3. Spousal bequests to maximise portability: Ku hlela vukati bya wena leswaku estate hinkwayo yi ya eka nkat'awu yi yisa duty hinkwayo eka rifu ra vumbirhi, hi nkarhi lowu abatements yi nga cinca, kumbe estate ya nkat'awu leyi hanyaka yi nga hleriwa hi ndlela yin'wana.

4. Miko to nkarhi wa vutomi: Tiyiko ta ku fika eka R100 000/lembe ti ntshunxekile eka Donations Tax. Ku tlula malembe ya 20, R2iliyoni yi nga hundziseriwa handle ka estate ya wena, yi hlayisa R400 000 eka estate duty.
<p><strong>1. Sole Proprietor:</strong>:
1. Sole Proprietor: Ku hava ku hambana exikarhi ka wena ni bindzu. Mihuro hinkwayo yi hakerisiwa mhakaxaxa tanihi mali ya xiyexe (ku fika eka 45%). Vutihlamuleri bya xiyexe bya ku nga hleriwi. Nkoka wa ku sungula i zero. Yi tirha eka vafambisi va rhanga ehansi ka R1m turnover.

2. Private Company (Pty Ltd): Xiyenge xa nawu xa ku hambana. Xiyenge xa mhakaxaxa xa khoporate xa 27%. Vusikete bya vutihlamuleri bya xiyexe (bya ku hleriwa). Yi lava ku tsarisiwa ka CIPC. Yi lulamile eka mabindzu lama tlulaka R500k turnover.

3. Personal Service Provider (PSP): Pty Ltd laha 80%+ ya mali leyi ngenaka yi humaka eka mintirho eka vaxavi van'we kumbe vambirhi. SARS yi hakerisa ma-PSP eka xiyimo xa 28-45% (ku nga ri xiyimo xa 27% xa khoporate), leswi i xikhamba lexi vafambisi vo tala va waka eka xona.

4. Small Business Corporation (SBC): Pty Ltd leyi fanelekaka eka mintengo ya mhakaxaxa leyi hungutiweke. Mali leyi ngenaka hinkwayo ehansi ka R20iliyoni. Ku hava mu-shareholder loyi a nga khomaka ti-share eka khampani yin'wana. Xiyimo xa mhakaxaxa: 0% eka R95 750 ro sungula, kutani 7%-27% eka ti-tier. Eka ti-SME leti fanelekaka, leswi swi hlayisa mhakaxaxa leyikulu.

<p><strong>Anchoring:</strong> the first:
Anchoring: ntsengo wo sungula lowu u wu vonaka wu cinca ndlela leyi u avanyisaka ha yona ntsengo wun'wana ni wun'wana endzhaku ka wona. Jakete ra R5 000 ri endla leswaku ra R2 000 ri twala 'ri nga durhi'. Hambi loko R2 000 ya ha ri yikulu.

Sunk cost fallacy: ku hambeta u endla swo karhi hikwalaho ka mali leyi humesiwaka kale, hambi loko yi nga ha twali. 'Ndzi hakerile jimu, hikokwalaho ndzi ta hambeta ndzi ya hambi loko ndzi nga yi rhandzi': ku pimanisa ni ku pfala ni ku yimisa kulova ka vumundzuku. Mali leyi fambe kale yi nga hleri xiboho xa wena lexi landzelaka.
<p><strong>Anchoring:</strong> When the:
Anchoring: Loko ntsengo wo sungula lowu u wu vonaka wu khumba ndlela leyi u avanyisaka ha yona minengo hinkwayo ya vumundzuku. Xikombeko: ku vona jakete ra R5 000 ri endla leswaku jakete ra R2 000 ri vonaka 'ri nga durhi', hambi loko ra ha durha.

Sunk cost fallacy: Ku hambeta u endla swo karhi hikwalaho ka mali leyi humesiwaka kale, hambi loko yi nga ha twali. 'Ndzi hakerile vukhoma bya jimu kale, hikokwalaho ndzi ta ya hambi loko ndzi byi venga' vs. 'Ndzi hakerile kale, kambe ndzi fanele ku pfala ni ku yimisa ku lovisa tin'hweti ta vumundzuku.'
<p><strong>Asset allocation</strong> (ho: Asset allocation (ndlela leyi u avanyisaka ha yona exikarhi ka ti-equity, tibodo, miako ni mali) yi fambisa ku cincacinca ka minengo ya wena, ngopfu ku tlula ti-share leti u ti hlawulaka. Pfumelela time horizon ya wena yi hlela: mali ya nkarhi woleha yi nga rhwala ku cincacinca ka ti-equity, mali leyi laviwaka endzeni ka malembe mambirhi yi nga swi koti. Vahlaluri vo tala va SA va khoma ku humela handle ka tiko hikuva muhuro wa vona, kaya ni mali swi le rivaleni hi kuhelela. Regulation 28 yi veka mpimo wa xihlovo xa le handle xa ntumbuluko wa ntsengo wa 45%.

<p><strong>Bitcoin (BTC):</strong> Creat:
Bitcoin (BTC): Yi tumbuluxiwile hi 2009. Xikongomelo xikulukumba: xihlayisi xa ntsengo ('golide ya dijitari'). Nhlayo leyi yimeke ya 21 wa miliyoni wa mintshava. Protocol yo olova, a yi cinca ngopfu hi mianakanyo. Yi khomiwile swinene, yi seketeriwa swinene hi tihlangano.

Ethereum (ETH): Yi tumbuluxiwile hi 2015. Blockchain leyi hleriwaka leyi pfunaka smart contracts, DeFi, ni NFTs. Nhlayo leyi cincacincaka (leyi tlakusaka/leyi hungutaka). Yi rhendzeleke, yi hluvukisiwa hi matimba.
<p><strong>Bitcoin</strong> has a protoc: Bitcoin yi ni mpimo wa protocol lowu sindzisaka wa 21 wa miliyoni naswona yi hleriwile ngopfu tanihi xihlayisi xa ntsengo lexi kayivelaka, hambi lespeka ku kayivela handle ka ku lavisa a ku tiyisisi nchumu. Ethereum yi hleriwa: smart contracts ti hetisisa mintwanano hi ku tiendla, naswona ti hetisisa swihoxo hi ku tshembeka loku fanaka. Ringanisa xiyenge xihi ni xihi leswaku ku lahleka ka kuhelela ku ta tsakisa ku tlula ku vavisa, naswona u nga tshuki u lombisa ku xava.
<p><strong>Capital appreciation:</strong:
Capital appreciation: Xava hi R100, xavisa hi R150 = R50 ya vuyelo. Yi le hansi ka CGT (18% effective) loko yi ri eka akhawunti leyi nga riki ya TFSA.

Dividends: Mali leyi tolovelekile leyi humaka eka bindzu. Dividend Withholding Tax ya 20% yi tirha (ku nga ri eka TFSA).

Tip: Ku veka nakambe ti-dividend (DRIP) swi hoxa vuyelo bya wena hi matimba hi ku famba ka nkarhi.
<p><strong>Cash flow</strong> is income: Cash flow i mali leyi ngenaka yi humesa leyi humesiwaka. Yo tsakisa yi vula surplus yo aka rifuwo; yo homboloka yi vula ku buyela endzhaku. Eka mali leyi ngenaka. Swiphiqo swo tala i swiphiqo swa ku tirhisa mali, ku nga ri swiphiqo swa mali leyi ngenaka, hikokwalaho ku hunguta swilo i ku lulamisa loku hatlisaka, loku lawuriwaka. Kongomisa surplus yin'wana ni yin'wana hi xikongomelo.

<p><strong>Confirmation bias</strong> is: Confirmation bias i ku lavisa vuxokoxoko lebyi seketelaka leswi u swi pfumelaka kale, naswona swi twala ku fana na ndzavisiso. Endzhaku ka ku xava, mahungu lamanene ma va ya nkoka naswona mahungu yo biha ma va mpfumawulo. <p><strong>Duration</strong> measures ho:
Duration measures how sensitive a bond's price is to interest rate changes. A bond with a duration of 5 years will change in price by approximately 5% for every 1% change in interest rates.

Long-duration bonds (10-20 years) are more sensitive to rate changes. Short-duration bonds (1-3 years) are less sensitive.

SA context:

  • RSA Retail Bonds: no duration risk, you hold to maturity and the price is locked. Perfect for risk-averse investors.
  • Bond ETFs (Satrix Bond ETF, NewFunds GOVI ETF): hold a mix of government bonds. Have duration risk but also capital gain potential when rates fall.

For a buy-and-hold investor, duration risk is mainly psychological. For investors who need to sell before maturity, it's a real risk.
<p><strong>Fixed-rate bond:</strong> Pay:
Fixed-rate bond: Pays a set coupon for the bond's life. Good when you expect rates to fall.

Inflation-linked bond (ILB): Capital and coupon adjust with CPI. Guarantees a real return above inflation. Ideal for retirees who need to preserve purchasing power long-term.
<p><strong>Good debt</strong> builds wea:
Good debt builds wealth or income: home loan on appreciating property, student loan for a high-return degree, business loan funding profitable operations.

Bad debt funds consumption: clothing accounts, personal loans for holidays, credit card debt from lifestyle spending, car finance on a depreciating luxury vehicle.
<p><strong>Gross Profit Margin:</strong>:
Gross Profit Margin: (Revenue - Cost of Goods Sold) ÷ Revenue. Measures how much you retain before overheads. A retail business at 25% GP margin is normal. A software business at 70%+ is normal. Compare to your industry benchmark.

EBITDA Margin: Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation, and Amortisation ÷ Revenue. The cleanest measure of operational profitability. Used in business valuations (see next lesson).

Current Ratio: Current Assets ÷ Current Liabilities. Above 1.5 = healthy. Below 1 = potential liquidity crisis, you may not be able to pay bills in 12 months.

Debtor Days: (Debtors ÷ Revenue) × 365. How long customers take to pay. 30 days is standard; 90+ days is a cash flow problem. Every day of debtor days = revenue sitting uncollected.

Net Profit Margin: Net profit ÷ Revenue. After all costs including tax. Most healthy SMEs: 8-20%.
<p><strong>Guaranteed annuity:</strong>:
Guaranteed annuity: Fixed monthly income for life. No investment risk. Income never runs out. Less flexible.

Living annuity: You control drawdown (2.5-17.5%). Investment risk remains with you. Can run out if drawdown is too high or markets perform poorly.

Most retirees benefit from a hybrid - guaranteed annuity for living costs, living annuity for discretionary spending and estate preservation.
<p><strong>Hedonic adaptation</strong> i: Hedonic adaptation is the return to your usual level of happiness after a change. The new car thrills you for weeks, then becomes the car, which is why the next upgrade always feels necessary. Experiences resist it better than possessions, because they become memories rather than background. The strongest counters: bank part of every raise before adapting to it, space out treats so they stay treats, and deliberately notice what you already have.
<p><strong>Herd mentality</strong> is th:
Herd mentality is the pull to do what everyone else is doing. Our brains read a moving crowd as proof the direction is right. FOMO (fear of missing out) is its emotional engine.

The problem: the crowd usually arrives late, after prices have already run, and buys just as early holders sell. Protect yourself with three questions. Do I understand what I'm buying? Would I buy it if no one was talking about it? Can I explain how it makes a return?, and a rule to wait 48 hours before acting.

<p><strong>Mental accounting</strong> is:
Ku hlaya ka mbilu i ku va ni ku navela ko khoma mali hi ndlela yo hambana hi ku ya hi laha yi humaka kona kumbe xikongomelo xa yona, hambi ku ri leswaku mali yi fanana (randi yin'we yi fana na randi yin'wana).

Ku hlaya ka mbilu i xivangelo xa leswaku vanhu va rhwala swikweleti swa xiyimo xa le henhla na ku tshemba timali letikulu ta ntswalo wutsongo hi nkarhi wun'we, ku nga ku hlanganisa loku nga riki ka kahle.

<p><strong>Overconfidence bias:</strong>:
Mboyamelo wa ku tshemba ngopfu: Vanhu vo tala va pimi vutivi bya vona bya ku chayisa, ku veka mali, na ku endla swiboho tanihi 'bya le henhla ka xiyimo', lexi nga ri ki ntiyiso hi ku hlayela ka timali eka vo tala. Eka ku veka mali, ku tshemba ngopfu ku vanga ku xavisa ngopfu, ku nga avelani hi ku ringana, na ku teka khombo leri tlulaka vutivi bya wena bya ntiyiso.

Dyondzo ya swikolo yi kombisa nkarhi hinkwawo leswaku vatirhisi va xiyimo lava xavisaka ngopfu va kuma mbuyelo wo biha swinene, hileswi mintirho ya ku xava yi vangelaka leswaku ku xava eka xiyimo xa le henhla ku mbariwa hi nkarhi. Vatirhisi lava nga tirisiki ngopfu (lava nga endlingi nchumu) va hlula vatirhisi lava tirhisaka ngopfu.

Mboyamelo wa nkarhi lowu hundzeke: Mianakalu yi lemerisa swilo swa nkarhi lowu hundzeke hi ku angata leswaku swiyimo swa sweswi swi ta yela emahlweni. Endzhaku ka malembe ya 3 ya mbuyelo wa matimba eJSE, vatirhisi va langutela mbuyelo wa matimba. Endzhaku ka ku wa, va langutela ku wa lokun'wana. Ku hlahluva lokun'wana ku hoxile ngopfu ku tlula ku va ka kona ko lulama.

Nkwama wa Khale (Vested Pot): Siku rin'wana ni rin'wana emahlweni ka 1 Setembara 2024, milawu ya khale ya ha tirha.
<p><strong>SEFA (Small Enterprise Financ:
SEFA (Small Enterprise Finance Agency): Swikweleti leswi seketeriwaka hi mfumo ku sukela eka R10 000 ku ya eka R15 miliyoni. Ya durha kutsongo ku tlula mimpimo ya banka, yi endleriwile Mabindzu lamanene lama nga fanelekiki ku kuma swikweleti swa banka ya mabindzu. Mabindzu ya vatiko wa ntshunxeko na ya vavasati ma kuma mahlweni.

IDC (Industrial Development Corporation): R1m-R1 biliyoni eka swikweleti na migingiriko. Xikongomelo: vuhumelerisi, vurimi, vupfhumba, ikonomi ya rihlaza. Mikoka yo leha, leyi vekiselaka ku tlula tibanka.

DTI Incentives (sweswi DTIC): Manufacturing Development Incentive (MDI), Support Programme for Industrial Innovation (SPII), Aquaculture Development, Tourism Support Programme. Tin’wana i swihiwa (leswi nga hakeriwiki) eka mabindzu lama faneleke.

NDA (National Development Agency): Swihiwa eka NPO ni mintlawa ya vaaki.

Vuxokoxoko bya nkoka: Vatsakamisi vo tala va SA a va kombeli swihiwa swa mfumo. Mpfuxeto wu ni vuhundzu kambe mali a yi hunguti migingiriko (a wu nyikeli migingiriko). Eka mabindzu lama lavaka mali leyi kulu, xihumelerisi xa DTIC kumbe xikweleti xa IDC xi nga endla ku hambana ka xiviri.
<p><strong>Sole proprietor:</strong> no:
Munhu un’we (Sole proprietor): a ku na ku hambana na wena, bindzu ri horisiwa mokelelo eka mpimo wa wena (ku fika eka 45%), vutihlamuleri bya munhu byi nga heriki, xiyimo xa ku sungula i zero. Pty Ltd: xiyimo xa nawu lexi hambaneke ni vutihlamuleri lebyi hungutiwaka na mokelelo wa khamphani wa 27% (tikhamphani tinene leti faneleke, ku ncinca ehansi ka R20m, ti kuma mimpimo ya SBC leyi hungutiweke).

Mintila mimbirhi leyi u faneleke ku yi tiva: Personal Service Provider (Pty Ltd leyi kumaka 80%+ ku suka eka vatirhi van’we kumbe vambirhi va mintirho ya munhu) yi horisiwa mokelelo eka mimpimo ya munhu, ku nga ri 27%. Naswona migingiriko eka khamphani ya wena yi tshama endzeni ka rifuwo ra wena, kasi rifuwo ra trasti a ri kona, hi yona mhaka leyi mimpimo ya le henhla hakanyingi yi fambisaka khamphani ya ku xavisa na trasti ya ndangu leyi khomeke migingiriko.
<p><strong>Suspension</strong> is tempor:
Ku yimisiwa (Suspension) i ka nkarhanyana naswona ku nga ha va ni swilaveko leswi FSP yi faneleke ku swi fikelela leswaku swi susiwa. Ku humesiwa (Withdrawal) swi helisa mpfumelelo. Layisense yi tlhela yi hela (lapses) eka swiyimo swin’wana - xikombiso, loko FSP yi helisiwa hi ku helela kumbe (e ka munhu wa xiviri) u fa.

Hambi endzhaku ko humesiwa kumbe ku hela, vutihlamuleri eka vatirhi (ni eka FSCA) lebyi humeleleke emahlweni ka xiyimo lexi bya yisa emahlweni - a wu nge balekeli vutihlamuleri hi ku nyikela hi layisense.
<p><strong>Tax:</strong> SARS treats cry:
Mokelelo (Tax): SARS yi khoma crypto tanihi rifuwo leri horisiwaka mokelelo. Mokelelo wa ku antswa ka rifuwo loko u yi khoma u tlhela u xava (40% ya ku antswa yi nghena eka muholo), mokelelo wa muholo loko u xavisa ngopfu. Hlayisa mintivo ya swiendlo swin’wana ni swin’wana, naswona tsundzuka leswaku ku cincana ka SA (Luno, VALR) ti hlanganyela vuxokoxoko na SARS.

Vugevenga (Scams): Afrika Dzonga yi lahlekeriwe hi tibiliyoni eka vugevenga bya crypto (MTI ntsena, ~R9 miliyoni). Swikombiso swa khombo: ku tiyisisa mbuyelo wa n’wheti, mbuyelo lowu u nga kotiki ku wu humesa tanihi randi, ku hava xiyimo lexi hlamuseriweke, ku hlengeleta hi mintlawa ya kereke kumbe ndangu, ni ku hava layisense ya FSCA.
Tithe yi vula xiyenge xa khume. Mfuwo lowu wu sungurile Nawu wu nga si va kona, Abraham u nyika xiyenge xa khume eka Genesa 14, naswona Malaki 3:10 yi rhamba Israyele ku tisa xiyenge hinkwaxo xa khume ni ku ringela vukorheri bya Xikwembu. Matsalwa a ma veki nawu hi ta xiyenge xa le henhla eka xa le hansi, naswona 2 Vakorinto 9:7 yi veka ku tika eka mbilu leyi tiyimiseleke, leyi tsakileke ku ri na ku va nawu. A yi tshembisi leswaku ku aba ku tshembisa rifuno, naswona ku dyondzisa leswaku yi endla tano swi twisa vusiwana vanhu lava tsakeke ngopfu lava nga kotiki ku swi rhwala.
<p><strong>Treating Customers Fairly (TC: Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) i maendlelo lama sekelwaka eka vuyelo. Vuyelo bya tsevu: (1) vakaziteri va tiyiseka leswaku va khomiwa hi ku lulama; (2) swivekisiwa/swipfuno swi endleriwile ku fikelela swilaveko swa mintlawa leyi tiviwaka ya vakaziteri; (3) vakaziteri va nyikiwa vuxokoxoko lebyi lombeleke naswona va tivisiwa; (4) switsundzuxo swi fanerile ni swiyimo; (5) swivekisiwa swi endla hilaha vakaziteri languteleke hakona; (6) ku hava swirho swa endzhaku ko xava swo pfimba swaku va cinca xivekisiwa, va cinca muhumuseri, va tisa xikoxo kumbe va vilela.
<p><strong>Treating Customers Fairly</st: Treating Customers Fairly yi veka vuyelo bya tsevu. Ku khoma hi ku lulama, kuyila loku fanelaka, vuxokoxoko lebyi lombeleke, switsundzuxo leswi fanelaka, swivekisiwa leswi endlaka hilaha ku languteriweke, ni (Vuyelo 6) ku hava swikhoma swa endzhaku ko xava swo pfimba. FSPs ti tirhisa maendlelo ya swivilelo swa le ndzeni lama tsariweke naswona ti fanele ku byela vakaziteri ndlela yo tlakusela eka FAIS Ombud.
<p><strong>UIF (Unemployment Insurance F:

Xikombiso: Muholo wa R20 000 → u hakela R200, mutirhi wa wena u hakela R200 = R400/n’hweti eka nkwama lowu u nga ta vuyiseriwa eka wona endzhaku.

UIF (Unemployment Insurance Fund) i 1% ya muholo wa wena, leyi hakeriwaka ni hi mutirhi wa wena, leyi pfunaka loko u tlangisa ntirho wa wena, u ya eku wuhomisi ka vana, kumbe u lava swiyimo swa vuvabyi. Yi pimiwile eka ntsengo wa le henhla wa R17 712 hi n’hweti, hikwalaho leyi tlulaka hi ku hakeriwa hi matlhelo mumbirhi i R177.12. Eka R12 000: u hakela R120, mutirhi wa wena u hakela R120, eka nkwama lowu u nga claim-a eka wona endzhaku.
<p><strong>VAT:</strong> registration is:
VAT: ku tsalisa i ka Xivandla loko mali leyi ngensaka lembe na lembe yi tlula R1 000 000. U engetela 15% eka ti-invoice, u vuyisa VAT eka swiyenge swa bindzu, naswona u hakela SARS mali leyi salaka (output VAT leyi hlengeletiwaka − input VAT leyi hakeriwaka).

Provisional tax: lava tirhaka hi voxe va hakela hi ku pimanyisa kabiri hi lembe (ku rhendzeleka ka makumu ya August na makumu ya February). Nawu wa ntolovelo: veka etlheleni 25-35% ya ntsengo hinkwawo lowu amukeriwaka; leyo i xori ya wena ya nkarhi lowu taka, ku nga ri mali yo xava.

<p>A 'snowflake payment' is any extra lu: Hakelo ya 'snowflake' i nkokele wuhi na wuhi wa nkarhi lowu hundzeke lowu tlulaka wa xikweleti xa ntsengo wa xiyindlu. Hambi R5 000 leyi hakeriwaka eka Lembe ra 1 ra xiyindlu xa malembe ya 20 yi hlayisa kwalomu ka R20 000-R25 000 ya ntsengo wa xikweleti eka nkarhi hinkwawo.
<p>A <strong>bond</strong> is a debt ins:
Bond i xitirho xa xikweleti. Loko u xava bond, u lombisa mali eka muhumuseri (mfumo kumbe khampani) hi ku cincana na:

  1. Swihakelo swa ntswalo (leswi vitaniwaka coupon) hi xiyimo lexi tiyeke
  2. Ku vuyiseriwa ka malixidzi ya wena (mali leyi u yi lombiseke) hi siku ra maturity (siku ro hetelela)

Xikombiso: U xava R10 000 ya RSA Retail Bond leyi nga ni coupon ya 10% ni ku fika emakumu ka malembe ya 5. U amukela R1 000/lembe eka ntswalo. Endzhaku ka malembe ya 5, u kuma R10 000 ya wena yi vuya.

Vahumuseri va bond: Mfumo wa SA (RSA Retail Bonds, Treasury bonds), SOEs (Eskom bonds), masipala, na tikhabinete leti xavisaka (corporate bonds).
<p>A <strong>debit card</strong> spends: Debit card yi tirhisa mali leyi u nga na yona. Credit card yi tirhisa ya banka, hi 20%+ loko u ri na xikweleti lexi salaka, kambe yi nyika ku sirheleleka ka chargeback ni ku kuma mfungho loko u heta hinkwaswo n’hweti yin’wana ni yin’wana. Loko yi herisiwa n’hweti yin’wana ni yin’wana i xitirho xo kala xi nga ri na mali; loko yi khomiwe, i xin’wana xa swikweleti swo durha swinene leswi u nga swi khomeke. Cash advances a ti na nkarhi wa mahala wa ntsengo wa xikweleti at all.
<p>A <strong>guaranteed (life) annuity</: Guaranteed (life) annuity yi hakela ku ringana nkarhi lowu u hanyaka ha wona. Muhumesi wa inshuwalansi u teka khombo ra vuhanyi, naswona u nyikela hi ntsengo wa mali. Living annuity yi ku pfumelela ku hlawula swivekisi ni ku hoxa mali exikarhi ka 2.5% na 17.5%, yi veka ntsengo wa mali wu famba eka vadyana-ndzhaka, naswona yi siya khombo eka wena. Nhlamulo leyi tolovelekileke i hybrid: tiyisisa tindleko ta wena ta nkoka, u veka xiyenge lexi nga faneliki xi antswa. Tinhlamuselo hinkwato ti hakelelwa tanihi mali leyi ngenaka.
<p>A <strong>JSE-listed global ETF</stro: JSE-listed global ETF yi ku nyika ku vonakala ka masheya ya misava ni ku vonakala ka randi, leyi xaviwaka laha kaya hi tirandi, ku hava m pfumelelo wa SARS, ku hava mpimo lowu tirhisiwaka. Loko randi yi famba ku suka eka R17/$ ku ya eka R19/$ na timakete ti ri leti fase, R100 000 ya wena yi va kwalomu ka R111 800. Ku humesa tirandi ta xiviri u ri na R2m Single Discretionary Allowance ni R10m FIA hi ku pfumeleriwa hi SARS. Regulation 28 yi pimiwa swivandla swa vuhlayiseko eka 45% offshore. Mali ya ku hlawula yi ntshunxekile.
<p>A <strong>rug pull</strong> is develo: Rug pull i loko vayingiseri va ntsengo va humesa mali leyi hlengeletiwaka va nyamalala, naswona hikuva swiendlo a swi vuyiselwi endzhaku, mali yi lovile. FSCA a yi kambisisi smart contracts, naswona hambi protokolo leyi kambisisiweke exihundleni yi humesiwile. Loko puratifomo yi tshembisa 40% eka stablecoins, xivutiso xo rhanga i laha yield yi humaka kona; loko ku hava loyi anga yi hlamuselaka kahle, nhlamulo hi ntolovelo i vanhu lava nga vamba. Ku hava xifunengeto xa CODI naswona ku hava ombud laha.
<p>A 13th cheque or performance bonus is: Chege ra 13 kumbe bonasi ya ntirho i ntiyiso wa mali leyi ngenaka kan’we, naswona yo tala ya yona yi hela endzhaku ka tin’hweti tinharhu. Tibonasi ti hakelelwa hi kuhelela tanihi mali leyi ngenaka ya ntirho hi xiyimo xa wena xa le henhla, hikokwalaho pulana hi ntsengo lowu salaka. Endla xiboho xa ku avanyisa ema mali yi nga se fika: xikweleti xa ntsengo lowukulu ni xiyenge xa ximbirhi xa nkarhi wa ximumu xo rhanga, kutani ku tsakela.

<p>A bad credit score costs you money ev:

<p>A balloon (residual) makes instalment: Balloon (residual) yi endla leswaku swihakelo swi vonaka swi xaveka hi ku hundzisa 20-30% eka ku hela ka khontiraka. Eku heleni ka nkarhi u fanele: ku hakela balloon ya cash (vo tala va nga swi koti), ku yi lulamisa nakambe (ngetela ntsengo wa xikweleti), kumbe ku vuyisa movha. Vaxavi vo tala va SA va lulamisa nakambe hi ku pheta-pheta - va hakela ntsengo wa xikweleti hi ku kala va nga na nkarhi wo va ni movha.
<p>A blockchain is a distributed ledger:
Blockchain i ntsengo lowu hangalaskisiweke - database leyi yendliweke eka tikhompyuta ta magidi hi nkarhi wun’we. Xiendlo xin’wana ni xin’wana xi: hlanganisiwile eka 'block', xi boheleriwile hi vuxaka bya cryptography eka block leyi hundzeke (yi vumba xirhendze), naswona yi tiyisisiwile hi vatirhi va network (valimi kumbe vadyondzisiwa).

Ku hava nhlangano wun’we lowu yi fumaka. Ku cinca rungula rihi na rihi ra khale swi ta lava ku cinca block yin’wana ni yin’wana leyi landzelaka eka khopi yin’wana ni yin’wana hi nkarhi wun’we - swi nga koteki hi khompyuta.
<p>A bond is a loan you make to a govern: Bond i xikweleti lexi u xi endlaka eka mfumo kumbe khampani. Va ku hakela ntsengo wa xikweleti (coupon rate) naswona va vuyisa ntsengo wa mali ya wena eku heleni ka nkarhi. RSA Retail Bonds ti pfumelela Vafiloya va Afrika Dzonga ku lombisa mfumo hi ku kongoma ku nga ri na timali, ku sungula eka R1 000, eka intanete eka rsaretailbonds.gov.za.
<p>A bond originator (ooba, BetterBond,:
Muhumuseri wa bond (ooba, BetterBond, SA Home Loans) u rhumela xikombelo xa wena eka mabanka yo tala hi nkarhi wun’we naswona u burisana hi vumbirhi bya wena - ku nga ri na mali leyi u yi hakelelaka. Va kuma xiyimo xo antswa ku tlula ku komba banka yin'we hi ku kongoma.

Hambi xiyimo xa 0.25% xo antswa eka R1m eka malembe ya 20 xi hlayisa kwalomu ka R30 000 eka ntsengo hinkwawo wa xikweleti.
<p>A business can be profitable but have:
Khampani yi nga endla mbuyelo kambe yi nga vi na mali. Lenu i xiphiqo lexi tolovelekileke swinene xa ku wa ka SME e-SA.

Xikombiso: Khampani ya swakudya ya Priya yi rhumela invoyisi ya R500 000 hi March. Vaxavi va hakela endzhaku ka masiku ya 60 (May). U hakela miholo, swakudya, ni rent sweswi. Xitatimente xa mali xi komba R500 000 ya mali leyi ngenaka. Akhawunti ya yona ya banka yi komba -R200 000. U endla mbuyelo naswona mali yi nghena eka xiyimo lexi fana.

Ku ncinca ka mali: Nkarhi lowu nga exikarhi ka ku hakelela swilo ni ku hlengeleta eka vaxavi. Ku koma = ku antswa. Tindleko to komisa: lava vuhlayiseko, nyika xipano xo hatlisa ku hakela, hlwisa ku hakela vaxavi endzhaku ka swibumabumelo, factor debtors (xavisa invoyisi eka muhumuseri wa mali hi xipano).

<p>A Retirement Annuity (RA) is a long-t:

<p>A retirement fund death benefit is di: Mbuyelo wa rifu ra vuhanyi wu avanyisiwa hi vafambisi va section 37C: ku hlawula ka wena ku va kongomisa kambe a ku va bohi, naswona mbuyelo wu wela handle ka estate ya wena. Living annuity yi hundzela eka vadyana-ndzhaka va wena lava hlawuriweke; guaranteed annuity ya xitalo yi yimisa eka rifu. Estates ti lava liquidity, hikuva timali ta mufambisi (max 3.5% + VAT), timali ta koro ni swikweleti swi hakerisiwa nchumu wu nga se avanyisiwa, naswona swileriso a swi pfuxeti fometi ya ku hlawula.

<p>A shareholders agreement governs the:

Swiyenge swa nkoka leswi vadyana-masheya va SA va swi lavaka:

  • Tag-along: Loko mudyana-masheya wa ntsengo lowukulu a xavisa, vadyana-masheya va ntsengo wutsongo va nga joyina xaviso hi swiyimo leswi fanaka
  • Drag-along: Ntsengo lowukulu wu nga sindzisa ntsengo wutsongo ku xavisa loko muxavi a lava 100%
  • Right of first refusal: Emahlweni ka loko mudyana-masheya a xavisa eka munhu wa handle, vadyana-masheya va khale va kuma mfanelo yo rhanga yo xava hi ntsengo lowu fanaka
  • Deadlock resolution: Loko vadyana-masheya va ku ringana va nga pfumelani hi xiboho xa nkoka, ndlela yo tlucahata (buy-sell clause, mediation, arbitration)
  • Buyout on death/disability: I yini leswi humelelaka eka masheya loko mudyana-masheya a fa kumbe a nga ha koti ku tirha? Hakelela leswi hi inshuwalansi ya vutomi ni vulema.

<p>A trust is not a company and not a pe:

<p>A unit trust pools money from many in:

<p>Academic research (Fama-French, 1992:

<p>An <strong>RA</strong> gives you cont: RA yi ku nyika vufumi bya muhumuseri, mali ni tihakelo, naswona yi ku landzela exikarhi ka mitirho. Pensions ya le ntirhowo hakanyingi yi ta ni mavele ya mutirhi lawa hi ntolovelo ma tlulaka ku hambana ka tihakelo, hikwalaho tirhisa timbirhi loko u kota. Ntsengo lowu tsemiwaka wa 27.5% (lowu pimiweke eka R430 000) wu tirha eka minhlanganiso ya wena leyi hlanganyeriweke, naswona ku tlula ku ya emahlweni. Ehansi ka two-pot, xiyenge xa vunharhu xa minhlanganiso leyintshwa xi fikeleleka xi tlhela xi hakerisiwa xori hi mpimo wa wena; swiyenge swimbirhi swi tshama swi pfuleriwile.

<p>An ETF (Exchange Traded Fund) is a ba: ETF (Exchange Traded Fund) i ntsengo wa swilo swa mimpimo leyi xavisaka exandleni xa masheya tanihi xiyenge xin'we. Ku xava ETF kun'we ku ku nyika ku hangalaka ka nkarhi wolowo eka madzana kumbe magidi ya tikhamphani. Ti hlawulekile hileswi: hakanyingi ti ri ni TER ya le hansi (hakanyingi ehansi ka 1%), swiyenge leswi vonakaka, timali eka JSE, ni ku sirhelela xori endzeni ka TFSA. Tinhlengeletano tin'wana leti pfumeleriwaka eSA ti ku pfumelela ku ti xava hi ntsengo lowutsongo.
<p>An FSP must maintain a documented <st:
FSP yi fanele ku hlayisa mahelelwe ya swivilelo ya le ndzeni lama tsariweke: ya fanele ku fikeleleka eka vakleri, ku tlhantlha swivilelo hi ndlela leyinene ni hi nkarhi, ni ku hlayisa tiviko ta swivilelo ni vuyelo bya swona ku ringana malembe ya ntlhanu.

Loko xivilelo xi nga tlhantlhiwanga hi ku enerisa ka mukleri, mukleri u fanele ku byeriwa timfanelo ta vona ta ku rhumela mhaka eka FAIS Ombud, ni ndlela yo endla hi yona.
<p>An OTP <strong>authorises</strong> a: OTP yi pfumelela xiendlo. Yi nge pfuki yi sivelile xin'we, hi yona mhaka leyi ku hava bangi leyi nga ta ku vutisa yona. Vaxisi va pfula hi vito ra wena, nomboro ya ID ni swiendlo sweswinyana hileswi data leyi humeke yi nga durhiki; leyo i ntlango wa vumboni, ku nga ri vumboni. Ku hava chumu xo tanihi 'akhawunti ya vuhlayiseki': timali ta ntiyiso ti boha tiakhawunti, a ti ku vutisisi ku pfuxa mali. Vuyisa ufonela eka nomboro leyi u yi kumaka hi wena.
<p>An overdraft allows you to spend beyo: Overdraft yi ku pfumelela ku tirhisa ku tlula ntsengo wa wena ku ya fika eka mpimo lowu pfumeleriwaka. Timali ti hakerisa ntsengo (hakanyingi prime + 5-8%) eka ku hunguteka ka ntsengo, ku kula siku na siku. Overdraft leyi tamelaka ntsengo hi n’wedinkwavo i xikombiso xo tshwuka - swi vula leswaku u tirhisa ngopfu ku tlula leswi u swi kumaka.
<p>An overdraft lets you spend past zero: Overdraft yi ku pfumelela ku tirhisa ku tlula zero eka prime + 5–8%, ni ntsengo lowu kulaka siku na siku, lowu fanaka ni kumbe ku biha ku tlula khadi ra xikweleti. Tinhlengeletano tin'wana ti tlhela ti hakerisa mali ku katsa na loko u yi tirhisa kumbe hayi. Ku fikelela yona n’wedinkwavo i ku pfumala ka bajeti, ku nga ri vufumi bya mali, naswona mpimo lowukulu wu endla leswaku yi durha ngopfu.
<p>Anele saved R40 000 in a notice accou:

<p>Base cost is what you paid for the as:
Ntsengo wa xisekelo i leswi u swi hakeriweke xilo (ntengo wo xava + tihakelo ta broka + tihakelo ta ku antswisa ta property). Yi veka ntsengo wa nbuyelo wa wena.

Swilo swa nkarhi wo ranga ku pimisiwa: Loko a wu ri na swilo u nga si fika eka October 1 2001 (siku ra ku sungula ka CGT), ntsengo wa xisekelo wu nga kumeka hi ku tirhisa ntsengo wa misava eka siku leri, ku nga ri ntsengo wo xava wo sungula. Leswi hakanyingi swi hunguta ntsengo wa masheya kumbe property leyi khomisiweke nkarhi wo leha.

Leswi SARS yi swi languteleke: Hlayisa tiviko hinkwato ta khontrakiti (ku xava ka masheya), risiti ta xibalo xa ku hundzisa, invoyisi ta ku antswisa, ni mintwanano ya muendli wa property hi nkarhi hinkwawo. SARS yi nga kambela malembe ya 5 han’weti kambe yi nga ri na nkarhi wo pimiwa eka tiviko ta vuxisi. Bokisi ra switlhangu leri nga riki na tiviko i vuvabyi bya xori lebyi yimeleke ku endleka.

<p>Capital Gains Tax applies when you se:
Capital Gains Tax yi tirha loko u xavisa xilo hi ntsengo lowukulu ku tlula leswi u swi hakeriweke. CGT A HI xibalo xa Xiyenge - yi tirha hi ku katsa xiyenge xa ntsengo eka mali ya wena.

Eka vanhu: 40% ya ntsengo yi katseriwile eka mali leyi hakerisiwaka xori (leyi vuriwaka 'mpimo wa ku katsa'). Eka ntsengo wa R100 000, R40 000 yi engeteriwa eka mali ya wena naswona yi hakerisiwa xori hi mpimo wa wena. Eka 36%: CGT ya ntiyiso = R14 400.
<p>Capital Gains Tax is not a separate t:
Capital Gains Tax a hi xibalo xa xiyenge eSouth Africa. I ku engetela eka xibalo xa mali. Loko u susa xilo (xavisa, nyika, fa, kumbe ku suka etikweni), SARS yi katsa xiyenge xa vuyelo eka mali ya wena leyi hakerisiwaka xori ya lembe rero.

Mimpimo ya ku katsa ya 2024/25:

  • Vanhu: 40% ya ntsengo yi katseriwile eka mali leyi hakerisiwaka xori

<p>From 1 March 2017, SARS introduced Se:
Ku sukela hi 1 Ndzhati 2017, SARS yi tise Section 7C ku sivela pulani leyi tirhisiwaka ngopfu: vanhu va xavise nhundzu eka trust ya vona hi ntsengo wa xitsengo lowu tsaneke eka akhawunti ya xikweleti leyi nga riki na ntsengo, ku antswisa ntsengo eka estate ya vona.

Section 7C yi vula leswaku: Xikweleti xi xin'wana na xi xin'wana lexi humaka eka wena (munhu loyi a hlanganisiweke) eka trust eka ntsengo wa xibalo wa le hansi ka ntsengo wa xibalo wa ximfumo xi pfuxa Xibalo xa Minyiko eka ntsengo 'lowu honisiweke'. Eka ntsengo wa repo wa 7.75%, xikweleti lexi nga riki na ntsengo xa R10 wamiliyoni xi humesa R775 000 eka minyiko leyi anakanyiwaka hi lembe. Endzhaku ka ku humesiwa ka lembe ka R100 000, R675 000 yi le hansi ka Xibalo xa Minyiko xa 20% = R135 000/lembe.

Ku khumba: Mihandzu ya trust ya khale leyiakiwaka emahlweni ka 2017 sweswi i minongoloso ya xibalo ya lembe. Vapfuli ni vahlanganisi va fanele ku hakela ntsengo lowu faneleke eka swikweleti, ku rivalela xikweleti hi ku hlalalela, kumbe ku hlela nakambe.

<p>The <strong>FAIS Ombud</strong> (the:

<p>The <strong>Financial Advisory and In:

<p>The <strong>real interest rate</stron:
Ntsengo wa ntiyiso wa ntsengo = ntsengo wa nominal - ntsengo wa ntsengo wa swilo. Loku hi loku mali ya wena yi ku kumaka hi xiviri endzhaku ka loko ntsengo wa swilo wu nyikile mfanelo yo xava.

Xikombiso: Akhawunti ya wena ya vuhlayiseki yi hakela 9%. Ntsengo wa swilo i 5.5%. Mbuyelo wa wena wa ntiyiso i 3.5%, hi leswi ntsengo wa mfuwo wa wena wu kulaka ha swona hi ntiyiso eka mfanelo yo xava.

Mitseketelo ya ntiyiso leyi nga riki leyinene: Loko ntsengo wa swilo wu tlula ntsengo wa wena wa vuhlayiseki, mfanelo ya wena yo xava ya hunguteka hambi ku ri leswaku ntsengo wa wena wa rand wu kula. Hi 2020-2021, mitseketelo ya ntiyiso ya SA a yi ri kusuhi na zero kumbe leyi nga riki leyinene, mali a yi lovisa ntsengo hi ku rhula.

Eka ku aka mfuwo wa nkarhi wo leha, u lava swilo leswi hlulaka ntsengo wa swilo hi ku landza nkarhi. Lowu i nkongomiso wa nkoka wo vekisa eka ti-equity ku ri ku nga hlayisi mali hinkwayo eka mali.
<p>The <strong>repo rate</strong> (repur:
Ntsengo wa repo (ntsengo wo xava) i ntsengo wa ntsengo lowu South African Reserve Bank (SARB) yi nyikaka tibanki ta mabindzu mali hi vusiku byin'we. I xitirho lexikulu swinene lexi SARB yi xi tirhisaka ku lawula ntsengo wa swilo eSA.

Ntsengo wa repo wu veka xisekelo xa mitso hinkwayo ya ntsengo eka ikonomi. Xikweleti xin'wana ni xin'wana xa kaya, xikweleti xa movha, karata ya xikweleti, ni akhawunti ya vuhlayiseki eAfrika Dzonga yi pimiwa hi ku landza yona.

<p>The rand <strong>floats freely</stron: The rand floats freely: the SARB targets inflation, not an exchange rate, and defending a currency level against global capital flows rarely works. <p>The rand is one of the most traded an: The rand is one of the most traded and most volatile emerging-market currencies. <p>The rand is one of the most traded, a:
The rand is one of the most traded, and most volatile, emerging-market currencies. When global investors get nervous, they sell 'risky' assets (including rand) and buy 'safe' ones like the US dollar. This can happen even when nothing has changed inside South Africa.

Durable drivers of rand weakness include US–SA interest-rate differentials (capital flight to the dollar), load shedding and other growth shocks, a current-account (trade) deficit, and global risk-off sentiment.
<p>The real cost of moving money abroad: The real cost of moving money abroad hides in the exchange rate margin (2–4% at most banks), not the advertised fee. Compare the amount that actually arrives. <p>The rent vs buy decision depends on:: The rent vs buy decision depends on: property price growth in your area, rental yield, your expected tenure, opportunity cost of the deposit, and personal circumstances. In SA, the break-even point (when buying becomes financially superior to renting the equivalent property) is typically 7-10 years.
<p>The repo rate also affects the rand's:
The repo rate also affects the rand's exchange rate. Higher SA rates attract foreign capital seeking better yields, this increases demand for rand, strengthening the currency.

Lower rates relative to global peers make SA less attractive for foreign investment, weakening the rand. This is why the SARB sometimes holds rates higher than necessary purely for domestic inflation, to prevent rand weakness from importing inflation through fuel and food prices.

Practical implication: A rate cut cycle is often positive for SA borrowers but can weaken the rand, which raises petrol and imported goods prices, partially offsetting the benefit of lower debt costs.
<p>The risk-return tradeoff: higher pote: The risk-return tradeoff: higher potential returns require accepting higher risk. You're not compensated for avoidable risks (concentration, not diversifying). You ARE compensated for market risk (equities over time) through the equity risk premium - historically 4-6% above risk-free rates per year.
<p>The SARB can: raise interest rates (m:
The SARB can: raise interest rates (makes rand more attractive to foreign investors, supports the currency), intervene in currency markets using foreign reserves to smooth excessive volatility, and set monetary policy to manage inflation indirectly.

The SARB cannot: fix the exchange rate permanently, prevent rand weakness driven by global risk-off events, or control the dollar price of commodities SA exports.
<p>The SARB repo rate is the rate at whi: The SARB repo rate is the rate at which it lends to commercial banks. When it rises, your home loan, car finance, credit card and personal loan rates all go up within weeks. Prime rate = repo + 3.5%. Most SA home loans are priced at prime minus 0% to 2%.
<p>The SARB targets <strong>3% inflation: The SARB targets 3% inflation, with a ±1 percentage point tolerance band, a point target that replaced the old 3–6% range. What matters to you is the real return: 10.5% interest with 4.8% inflation is 5.7% real, and 6% with 8% inflation is a loss. That's why holding long-term savings entirely in cash isn't safe. It's a slow, certain erosion of purchasing power dressed up as caution.
<p>The single most reliable indicator of: The single most reliable indicator of investment fraud: a guarantee of specific returns. Every legitimate investment has risk. Government bonds have default risk. Bank deposits carry institutional risk. JSE shares have market risk. Anything promising guaranteed returns above the risk-free rate (currently ~8%) is either lying or structurally unsustainable (Ponzi).

<p>The transmission works in three steps:
Mbuyelo wu tirha hi mintirho mimbirhi:

  1. Mpimo wa ntswalo wa repo: Wu vekiwile hi Huvo ya Milletelo ya Timali ya SARB (MPC). Sweswi i 7.75% (makumu ya 2024).
  2. Mpimo wa ntswalo wa prime: Banka ta mabindzu ti engetela 3.5 tiphesente. Prime = repo + 3.5%. Loko repo yi ri 7.75%, prime = 11.25%.
  3. Mpimo wa wena: Tibankata ti ku lovisela hi prime ku hunguliwa kumbe ku engeteriwa hi xiyenge lexi sekeriweke eka xiyimo xa wena xa khombo. Xikweleti lexinene xa yindlu xi nga va prime - 0.5% = 10.75%. Xikweleti xa xiyalo xa munhu hi un'we xi nga va prime + 8% = 19.25%.

Loko MPC yi tlakusa kumbe ku hunguta mpimo wa repo, prime yi famba hi ku ringana hi ku kongoma, naswona xikweleti xin'wana na xin'wana xa mpimo lowu cincaka kumbe mali leyi vekiwile etikweni yi pfuxetiwa hi nkarhi wolowo.

<p>Value Added Tax (VAT) at 15% is inclu:
Value Added Tax (VAT) ya 15% yi nghenisiwe eka nxavo wa swilo swo tala ni vuhlekiseri. Swilo leswi nga riki na xibhalo (a ku na VAT): vuhodhi byo basa, manyi wa masi, masi, matandza, mirhi yo sweka leyi nga ni rihanyu, rice, timbuti leti omisiweke. Swilo leswi ntshunxekeke: renti ya tindlu, vuhlekiseri bya vanhu hinkwavo, vuhlekiseri bya dyondzo.

Tanihi xirho xa vaaki, u hakela VAT eka swilo swo tala hi ku tirhisa swona. Tanihi bindzu leri hundzaka R1m wa malingi, u fanele ku tsala tanihi xirho xa VAT.
<p>VAT is a consumption tax added to mos:
VAT i xolelo xa ku dyiwa lexi engeteriwaka eka swilo swotala na minongoloko. Mpimo lowu tolovetwaka i 15%. Eka xilo xa R100 lexi nga ni VAT, ku ringana R13.04 i VAT (R100 − R100÷1.15).

Ku nga ri na VAT (0%): swakudya swa Xisekelo, vuswa bya ntima na bya ku basa, maza, mpunga, tinyawa leti womisiwezi, tindluva, tinswa leti boxiwaka eka tinkomponi, mafurha ya swakudya, ntswamba, madandha, mihandzu na mimova: ti hlayisiwa ti durha hi xikongomiso. Ku ntshunxiwile: ku hlaya ka ndhawu ya vulelari, minongoloko yin'wana ya timali, vufambisi bya tiko. Madirektara: mali leyi nghenaka leyi hundzaka R1 000 000 hi lembe yi vula ku tsarisiwa ka VAT ka nkarhi hinkwawo. U hakerisa 15% naswona u rhumela mali leyi salaka eka SARS.
